caption: The drawing depicts a single large ceramic jug with a rounded body, narrow neck, and a small handle attached to the upper portion near the spout. The jug is colored in earthy tones of light beige to tan with a mottled texture, suggestive of stoneware. On the front, there are blue decorative patterns, possibly floral motifs, painted in a loose, stylized manner, featuring curved stems, leaves, and flower petals. Near the neck of the jug, there are some small, faint inscriptions in blue writing. The background is a solid, slightly textured pale beige color, with no additional objects or details, making the jug the sole subject of the composition.
title: Jug
